status: Three-scene paced host baseline accepted; both speculative read-path experiments rejected
scope: Linux headless host: deterministic guest owner plus bounded owned RGB/PCM output, production FrameScaler and OutputMixer, checksum sink. No physical display, audio transport or BlackBerry performance measurement.

procedure.cold_preparation: Replay the accepted M2 prefix, save complete state, verify a 120-frame restored continuation and checkpoint RGB, then trim the remaining recorded frame controls to the selected window.
procedure.correctness_oracle: Per-frame RGB hashes and stereo PCM extracted from the original accepted cold M2 recordings, independent of the measured profile repetitions.
procedure.iterations: Per scene and variant: two unreported paced warmups, three measured 900-frame runs. Baseline additionally has a separate diagnostic JFR pass, excluded from performance summaries.
procedure.isolation: Variants ran sequentially from immutable class directories; no Maven build or test run overlapped the measurements. Only Memory.class differs in experimental directories.
procedure.pacing: 1x, 16777216 guest cycles/s, 280896 cycles/frame; no guest or presentation skips; 32768 Hz stereo PCM at 100 percent volume, unmuted.
procedure.output: Owned 240x160 RGB and valid PCM copies per frame; queue capacity 2; 640x426 aspect-fit scaling, mixing and SHA-256 verification on a separate host worker.
procedure.metrics: Guest wall work and exact allocated bytes; owner CPU/allocation, drain, copy/submit, pacing wait, producer deadline misses, GC collection counters/time; worker scaling/mixing/hash CPU and queue counters.
procedure.gc_caveat: gc_collection_ms is the collector MXBean cumulative collection time delta, not a measured sum of stop-the-world pauses.
procedure.jfr_caveat: Execution samples attribute hotspots; weighted allocation samples are estimates and substantially exceed the exact ThreadMXBean totals here. Use exact per-thread allocated bytes for totals.
procedure.continuity_caveat: Zero capture-buffer losses and matching produced/consumed PCM do not qualify physical playback continuity, MMAPI gaps/latency or A/V drift.

candidate.decision: Rejected; small differences overlap baseline spread and are inconsistent across scenes.
candidate.description: Replace the aligned halfword region if chain with a region switch.

video-peek.decision: Rejected; no consistent improvement; Golden Sun regresses.
video-peek.description: Specialize aligned palette and VRAM peek16 reads before the unchanged fallback; CPU bus reads remain unchanged.

conclusion: No production core optimization retained. The measured scenes generally have host frame-budget headroom, with sporadic producer deadline misses. The queue never exceeds one waiting frame and no PCM/captured frames are lost. Read-path experiments do not establish a consistent useful improvement across scenes.
remaining_gate: Bold 9900 sustained playback and physical presentation/audio: 30-second warmup, three 10-minute runs, frame pacing, memory bounds, transport losses/latency and drift. No physical device is available; existing simulator limitations remain unchanged.
